creator: Alexander Terp
description:
From #153, batch 14, echo 2.

The `## Parameters` parser keeps only the first line of each bullet, so any parameter description wrapped in `docs/funcs/*.md` ends mid-sentence in `rad docs`:

```
- `_others` (`variadic `list|str`): additional sequences that get
- `reverse` (`bool`, keyword-only, default `false`): when true,
```

Reproduces on main for 8 parameters across `print`, `range` and `sort`. The same parse leaves a stray backtick in the type: the source writes `` (variadic `list|str`) `` and the parser's `strings.Trim(typeStr, "`")` strips only the trailing one. `funcdocs_test.go` checks signatures, not rendered parameters, so nothing caught it. LSP hover reads the same parsed docs and probably shows the same text (not checked).

Where: `rts/funcdocs.go:175` `parseParamsSection`.
title: rad docs drops the continuation lines of every wrapped parameter description
